text: Groupe Nedey Automobiles is a family business: the group's own site says it has been a new-car dealer for three generations and was founded by Valère Nedey.
short: Groupe Nedey is run by the Nedey family, now in its third generation.

source.name: Groupe Nedey: Notre histoire (nedey.com)
source.quote: Groupe Nedey Automobiles (GNA) est distributeur en véhicules neufs depuis 3 générations, fondé par Valère Nedey.
source.note: French: 'Groupe Nedey Automobiles (GNA) has been a new-car dealer for 3 generations, founded by Valère Nedey.' The page is undated.
